text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- One man is killed, several others injured and 56 people arrested after police clash with rioting street vendors in the Zambian capital on Wednesday.
- Chairman of the anti-corruption commission, Ali Hamir, urges western governments to curb the tendency by their companies to bribe government officials in developing nations.
- A presidential spokesman claims that riots by street vendors in the capital on Monday and Wednesday were instigated by former president Kenneth Kaunda.
- The fire brigade put out a fire at a government building housing vice president Godfrey Miyanda's office on Wednesday night. Part of the building was gutted by another fire on Tuesday night.
